Safety 
 Helmet, belt, shoes, .... etc
Spanners, Cleaning fluid, and Rags
Drain pump case and bearing housing.

Remove the constant level oilers to prevent 
 breakage.
Remove coupling cover.
Disconnect pump driver coupling.
Remove the coupling spacer and coupling spacer and coupling hub.
Disassembly pump bearing ( Driver side ).
Disassembly pump thrust bearing ( end side ).
Disassembly mechanical seal ( driver side & end side ).
Remove cooling water pipes.
Unbolt pump casing.
Lift out upper casing half.
Lift out pump shaft.
Remove the old gasket (from casing two halves).
Check pump base fixation .
Check driver shaft run out .
Check bearings housing for wear and cracks.
Check ball bearing condition (Change if needed).
Change lube. oil.
Check alignment between pump and motor.
Check upper & lower halves of pump casing for wear and cracks.
Check all impellers for wear and cracks.
Check wear rings sleeves - keys for wear and cracks.
Check stage piece center stage sleeve for wear , cracks and damage.
Check pump rotor for wear, damage and deformation.
Apply good cleaning for all pump parts.
Reinstall pump rotor in the lower casing half.
Put new gasket.
Reinstall upper casing half.
Rebolt upper and lower casing halves.
Reinstall mechanical seal in both sides.
Reinstall front and rear bearings .

Using heating reinstall coupling hub (pump&motor 
 shafts).
Do alignment check between pump & motor shafts.
Reinstall coupling sleeve and reassemble pump motor coupling.
Reinstall cooling water pipes.
